an5.34:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesālisaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.34:1.2: atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.34:1.3: sakkā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetunti?
an5.34:2.2: dāyako sīha dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo.
an5.34:2.3: yampi sīha dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:3.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti.
an5.34:3.2: yampi sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:4.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
an5.34:4.2: yampi sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, idampi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:5.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyako dānapati yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati: yadi khattiyaparisaṃ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ, yadi gahapatiparisaṃ, yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visāradova upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
an5.34:5.2: yampi sīha dāyako dānapati yaññadevaparisaṃ upasaṅkamati: yadi khattiyaparisaṃ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ, yadi gahapati parisaṃ, yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visāradova upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto: idampi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:6.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.34:6.2: yampi sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. idaṃ samparāyikaṃ dānaphalanti.
an5.34:7.1: evaṃ vutte sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.34:7.2: “yānimāni bhante bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi. ahampetāni jānāmi.
an5.34:7.3: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo manāpo.
an5.34:7.4: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, maṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti.
an5.34:7.5: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato: sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṅghupaṭṭhākoti.
an5.34:7.6: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati, yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamāmi: yadi khattiyaparisaṃ, yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ, yadi gahapati parisaṃ, yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visāradova upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
an5.34:7.7: yānimāni bhante bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni, nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi. ahampetāni jānāmi.
an5.34:7.8: yañca kho maṃ bhante bhagavā evamāha:
an5.34:7.9: ‘dāyako sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatī’ti etāhaṃ na jānāmi. ettha ca panāhaṃ bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmī”ti.
an5.34:7.11: dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
an5.34:8.1: dadaṃ piyo hoti bhajanti naṃ bahū
